description: NFX-16 §1: events every reader of namespace nfx:mainnet:1 MUST reject. Correctly signed except 'id-mismatch' and 'bad-sig'. 'reason' is informative.

cases.name: no-n
cases.reason: exactly one n tag is required (NFX-01 §3)

cases.name: two-n
cases.reason: exactly one n tag is required (NFX-01 §3)

cases.name: no-expiration
cases.reason: exactly one expiration tag is required

cases.name: scope-vpn-exit
cases.reason: a nostr-vpn exit rating, not a seeder rating

cases.name: rater-not-signer
cases.reason: the rater fact must be the event's pubkey

cases.name: self-rating
cases.reason: the subject must differ from the rater

cases.name: subject-npub
cases.reason: the subject is 64 lowercase hex, not bech32

cases.name: rating-101
cases.reason: the rating is within -100..100

cases.name: rating-plus-sign
cases.reason: the rating is a canonical decimal integer

cases.name: rating-leading-zero
cases.reason: the rating is a canonical decimal integer

cases.name: range-0-100
cases.reason: the range is exactly -100..100

cases.name: schema-2
cases.reason: only schema 1 is defined

cases.name: type-attestation
cases.reason: the record type is rating

cases.name: two-ratings
cases.reason: each required fact appears exactly once

cases.name: rating-two-values
cases.reason: each required fact holds one value

cases.name: no-created-at-fact
cases.reason: created_at is a required fact

cases.name: d-tag
cases.reason: a fact op carries no d tag

cases.name: e-tag
cases.reason: an NFX rating links to no other event

cases.name: uuid-uppercase
cases.reason: the record UUID is canonical lowercase

cases.name: two-subject-i
cases.reason: exactly one subject i tag

cases.name: content
cases.reason: the content is empty

cases.name: id-mismatch
cases.reason: edited after signing: the id no longer matches

cases.name: bad-sig
cases.reason: the signature does not verify
